title: infra-ontology node, v1
description: One row of nodes.parquet, in its JSON Lines form: one real thing (a resource, a module call, a state root, an account or a placeholder for something referenced but not read). It carries identifiers, never attribute values. Empty optional strings are omitted.

node_id.description: Stable identifier: the hex SHA-256 of the kind, cloud, account, region, type and native id (or its HMAC when ids are hashed).

cloud.description: The cloud, for example aws, azure or gcp. Empty for a node that is not in a cloud.

account.description: The scope: an AWS account, an Azure subscription or a Google project.

region.description: The region or location, where the resource has one.

tf_type.description: The Terraform resource type, where known, for example aws_s3_bucket.

inventory_type.description: The type in the live inventory, where known, for example AWS::S3::Bucket.

native_id.description: The identifier the cloud or the state gives the thing.

arn_or_path.description: The ARN, the Azure resource ID or the Google resource path, where known.

address.description: The Terraform address, for example module.net.aws_vpc.main[0]. Empty when Terraform does not manage the thing, or when the snapshot was built with --drop-addresses.

module.description: The module path of the address, for example module.net. Empty at the root, or when the snapshot was built with --drop-addresses.

root.description: The state source (a state root) that holds the node.

environment.description: The environment the node belongs to, for example prod or staging, where known.

tags.description: Tags, after the secret detectors. The one kind of value a snapshot keeps. In Parquet the column is a list of key and value pairs sorted by key.

confidence.description: How the node was learned: read directly, computed from read data, or inferred.

source_id.description: The source the node came from (a source_id in sources.parquet).
